decisions.baseline_expected_action: Move only after a double-threshold offer passes real relocation checks, then judge from lived work.
decisions.reason: Employment, lease, move cash and commute all pass after a years-long selective search.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Do not add housing lock-in until cash, role value and city commitment all pass together.
decisions.reason: Third window is the first time the cash rule passes while role value and city commitment are also explicitly acceptable.

constraint_check.notes: Small unit, emergency buffer retained, mobility cost acknowledged.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Use early negative checks to prevent a small project from becoming a new sunk-cost commitment.
decisions.reason: A counterexample candidate appears before proof investment expands.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Test method transferability only with independent reasoning and explicit failure criteria.
decisions.reason: A bounded nonexpert use case exists and earlier failures supply concrete trial design.

constraint_check.notes: No universal-method claim follows from one trial.

decisions.baseline_expected_action: Continue reducing expert lock-in only after the first rotation is stable.
decisions.reason: First rotation is stable and colleague capacity exists.

constraint_check.notes: Rare edge cases remain with Zhou during trial.

audit_rule: All final-horizon Q1 choices follow established thresholds and prior evidence; no abnormal trigger is used.
